work.math: The Hobby plan costs $9 a month and includes 15 credits. XS uses 5 credits. Registry use at $0.035 per unit and build usage are not priced.
$9 a month for Hobby, which includes 15 credits. XS uses 5 credits. Prorating 730 hours, registry use and build usage prevent an exact total.
29 credits means a $23 minimum ($9 plan + 14 excess). Add $0.05 per GB of backup, $0.035 per unit of registry use, and build usage.
